# telnyx_porting_order_additional_documents (Data Source)

Lists porting order additional documents, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_porting_order_additional_document`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id id.

### Optional

- `filter_document_type` (List of String) Filter additional documents by a list of document types
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort_value` (String) Specifies the sort order for results. If not given, results are sorted by created_at in descending order. One of `-created_at`, `created_at`.

### Read-Only

- `porting_order_additional_documents` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_order_additional_documents))

<a id="nestedatt--porting_order_additional_documents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `porting_order_additional_documents`

Read-Only:

- `content_type` (String) The content type of the related document.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `document_id` (String) Identifies the associated document
- `document_type` (String) Identifies the type of additional document
- `filename` (String) The filename of the related document.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies this additional document
- `porting_order_id` (String) Identifies the associated porting order
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.
